title: pathPlanningUR5.py: the planned path, traces, three scenes and the URDF graphics
author: Claude-JG
description: The motion goes through an intermediate configuration far off the goal. Decided: check and if needed revise the planner; sensor traces and the planned trajectory as ground object with spheres at the end of each part; two further more challenging scenes in the file; shadow and the URDF graphics of the UR5, the collision shapes switchable; more comments on the path planning and trajectories.
releaseNotes: ProfilePTP(syncAccTimes=True) is implemented and used by Trajectory.FromWaypoints, so that the motion between waypoints is their straight line in the coordinates; ShortcutPath connects points anywhere on the path. pathPlanningUR5.py has three scenes, the planned path, the sensor trace and the meshes of the UR5.
